prompt: Write 25 chat messages that contain NO person's name at all. These are casual chat messages as people type them on a phone: NO capital letters anywhere (not even at the start of the sentence or for names), little or no punctuation, abbreviations like pls, thx, u are fine. Hinglish means Hindi written in the Roman alphabet mixed with English (for example 'kal meeting hai', 'mujhe bata dena'), never Devanagari script. Every sentence must be different in structure and topic. Return ONLY a JSON array. Each message is an object with "text" and "names" (always an empty list) and "category". Category "word_that_can_be_a_name": messages that use ordinary words which are also sometimes first names, in their ordinary meaning (for example rose, joy, grace, deep, mark, will, summer, ruby, pooja as in the act of worship); and category "place": messages about cities, states, countries and landmarks.
